findings.description: Archive file opening without path validation - potential zip slip if used for extraction
findings.reasoning: This line sets a default filename if none is provided. It does not extract files to the filesystem - it only opens files within the archive. The actual zip slip vulnerability would occur if this opened file is later written to disk without path sanitization. This code itself doesn't perform extraction, so it's a false positive for direct zip slip.

evidence.dataflow_analysis: No dataflow analysis performed - this is just setting a default value
evidence.notes: The code creates archive objects and opens files within archives but doesn't extract to filesystem. Actual vulnerability would depend on calling code.
